data.body:
[P1] Keep the rejection handler attached to each literal import

Esbuild recognizes an optional import from a rejection handler attached to the import expression; it cannot follow the handler through `load()`. The three transport modules now contain bare literal imports, so consumers bundling `/ai` with optional AWS clients absent encounter resolution errors, including consumers using only HTTP. The package's Rollup build externalizes dependencies, so preserving runtime imports there does not validate this case. Attach `.catch()` directly to each literal `import()` and add a consumer bundle test with unused optional clients absent.
